author: Marlon Chaviano
name: monorepo-bun
title: Full-stack monorepo with Bun
description: Bun workspaces with an Elysia API and a React + Vite web app, connected with Eden: the client knows the API's types without code generation.

verify.command: bun run typecheck && bun run build

instructions:
## How to work here

- `apps/api` is the API (Elysia) and `apps/web` the web app (React + Vite). `packages/client` exports `api`, the Eden client: the web app imports from `@app/client` and gets the API's types without code generation.
- When you add an endpoint, declare it with its schema (`t.Object`) in `apps/api/src/index.ts`: that's how the client validates and types it.
- From the root: `bun run dev`, `bun run build`, `bun run typecheck`.
- Each app lives in its own folder with its own dependencies; don't mix code from one into another.
- Whatever backend and frontend share (types, API contracts) is defined in one place and documented.
